description: Start an alert rule test. By default (mode "dry_run") it runs the rule's query once on the app's real data and inserts nothing. Mode "live" first inserts 6 synthetic attack requests into the app's telemetry; only ask for it explicitly.

mode.description: dry_run (default, read-only) or live (inserts 6 synthetic attack requests).

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.
